<parameter name="body"># As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** 900+ mods bury our diagnostics under 50+ unrelated startup/save-load errors. ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (e.g. just Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene when a DBH test is needed, or Krkr.rule56 for the CAI 5000 pass — it pulls Prepatcher transitively) + build a fresh column via the dev action "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement". The user's real column SAVE was made under the full list so it can't load isolated. Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (identity x/z; -2.5 y is altitude/sort only; 0.85 per-object shrink about each thing's own center).
- Selection survives column view switches AND pawn level-changes via stairs. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap. Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through.**
- **Designators OUT OF SCOPE (user decision pass 33).**
- Logistics doctrine: every ferry MONOTONE. Storage=vanilla+capacity clamp + delivered-level retention (pass 34).
- **WORK doctrine (pass 36): the column is ONE BIG MAP for work priority.**
- **HAULING doctrine (pass 37): ONE BIG MAP for STORAGE PRIORITY.** Monotone.
- **COMBAT doctrine: cross-map verb casts are impossible (engine map guard), so we spawn projectiles on the TARGET map and run our own warmup/burst/cooldown driver.** Turret support CAPABILITY-based (any Building_Turret whose AttackVerb is a Verb_LaunchProjectile).
- **COMBAT VISUALS doctrine (pass 38): the REAL projectile reads the cross-gap shot at 1:1, no fake tracer.**
- **FOG-OF-WAR doctrine (pass 39): the column is ONE BIG MAP for VISION too, across the same open-air gap combat uses.** With CAI 5000's Fog of War enabled, the see-below view HONORS CAI fog (option B), and cross-level VISION reveal keeps holes lit where pawns can see across them. "Cross-level sight" = FoW VISION reveal only; it does NOT feed CAI's threat-AI enemy flags across the gap (AASB's own cross-level combat driver supersedes that).
- **Soft-compat HARD RULE (relearned pass 35):** foreign types (DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/CE/CombatAI) must NEVER appear in a method SIGNATURE or field. CAI is REFLECTION-ONLY: no CombatAI.dll compile reference at all.

# PASS 39 — OPTIONAL CAI 5000 (Krkr.rule56) SUPPORT: FOG OF WAR + CROSS-LEVEL VISION (IN PROGRESS)
User directive: "build optional support for CAI 5000 - Advanced AI + Fog Of War." Decisions: cross-level sight IN SCOPE (as FoW VISION reveal, not threat-AI feed); see-below honors CAI fog = **option B**.

**CAI 5000 is TWO systems.** (1) Advanced AI — ALWAYS on. (2) Fog of War — OPT-IN (`Finder.Settings.FogOfWar_Enabled` defaults FALSE). Harmony + optional Prepatcher.

**AUDIT (decompiled CombatAI.dll):** `Projectile_Patch` EMPTY -> AASB cross-gap rounds safe (we spawn projectiles directly), Advanced AI coexists free. CAI fog pipeline: per-map `SightTracker.colonistsAndFriendlies` shadow-casts player seers into an ITFloatGrid; `MapComponent_FogGrid` -> `CellFogState`; a postfix ORs `CAIFogged` into vanilla `FogGrid.IsFogged` when `FogOfWar_UseVanillaUnexplored` (default true) and not `DisableOnPlayerMap && IsPlayerHome`. Cross-level VISION seam = public LoS-correct `MapComponent_FogGrid.RevealSpot(IntVec3, radius, duration, applyRangeMultiplier)`.

**CAI ARCHITECTURE CONSTRAINT (to verify in-game):** `MapComponent_FogGrid.MapComponentUpdate` (render-tied) is called ONLY for the current map; `MapComponentTick` for all. So for the off-screen surface (while viewing the sky in see-below): its SightTracker stays live (all-map tick), its fog background thread MAY keep updating fogState (the `ready=false` line lives in the uncalled MapComponentUpdate), BUT the vanilla-fog-bit flush (asyncActions.ExecuteMainThreadActions in MapComponentUpdate) likely freezes. Net liveness of the see-below fog is UNCERTAIN from code (fog-vs-unfog asymmetry; differs default vs overlay mode) -> must OBSERVE in-game before deciding if Phase 4 needs an invasive "keep see-below surface fog current" patch.

**PHASE 1 — DETECTION/REFLECTION BRIDGE + GUARD + SELF-TEST (BUILT GREEN, in-game smoke OK run #209):**
- ABGuard `combatAI`; `Source/Compat/ABCombatAICompat.cs` (REFLECTION ONLY): `Active`, `Ready`, `FogEnabled`, `HasFogComp`, `RevealOnMap`, `StatusLine`; resolves MapComponent_FogGrid + RevealSpot + Finder.Settings + FogOfWar_Enabled. About loadAfter Krkr.rule56. Dev action `AB: CAI fog self-test`.

**PHASE 2 — SEE-BELOW HONORS CAI FOG IN ALL CONFIGS, OPTION B (BUILT GREEN, pending verify):**
- Default CAI mode: FREE (see-below gate reads vanilla `IsFogged` which carries CAIFogged). Overlay mode (UseVanillaUnexplored off): CAI sets no native bits, so added `ABCombatAICompat.OverlayFogMode` + `GetOverlayFogChecker(Map)` (delegate BOUND to `MapComponent_FogGrid.IsFogged`, non-null ONLY in overlay mode -> zero cost default) wired `|| caiFog(pos)` into `LevelRenderer.TryDrawFilteredDynamic` (below pawns) and `SectionLayer_ABBelowThings` (static). Self-test extended.

**PHASE 3 — CROSS-LEVEL FOG-OF-WAR VISION REVEAL PASS (BUILT GREEN, pending verify):**
- `Source/Compat/CrossLevelVision.cs`: `ScanPair(sky, surface)` driven from the sky comp (LevelComp level==1) on a 30t throttle, reveal duration 75, day/night radius 13-24 by target-level glow. Sky->surface: player pawns at a hole rim (own/neighbor cell AB_OpenAir + surface unroofed) -> RevealOnMap(surface, plumbCell). Surface->sky: player pawns under an open gap -> RevealOnMap(sky, cell). Seer = spawned, !Dead, !Downed player pawn. Skips entirely unless CAI FogEnabled AND a level of the pair is on screen. Reveals are bounded + deduped by cell (RevealSpot HashSet) so nothing leaks; a reveal applies on whichever level is CURRENT (CAI processes only the current map's queued reveals). ABGuard.CombatAI + ABCombatAICompat.Active gated in LevelComp.
- KNOWN CONSTRAINT (per the architecture note): sky->surface reveal while VIEWING THE SKY may not take live effect (surface off-screen); works while viewing the surface. surface->sky works while viewing the sky. Verify actual liveness in-game.

**REMAINING:** Phase 4 — based on in-game observation, decide whether to add an invasive patch to keep the see-below surface fog live while viewing the sky (Harmony on CAI's MapComponentUpdate, suppress its DrawFog to avoid overlapping the sky view) OR leave as-is; then polish + About/known-issues.json.

**OPEN ITEMS:** are sky/basement pocket maps IsPlayerHome (affects CAI DisableOnPlayerMap + indoor-visible)? RevealSpot sustained-use cost with many sky pawns? Live-ness of off-screen surface fog in the see-below.

# PASS 38 — CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT VISUALS: REAL 1:1 PROJECTILE, TRACER REMOVED (built green, pending verify)
Direct cross-gap rounds spawn at the shooter's plumb column and fly the full 1:1 distance; `CrossGapProjectiles` registry draws them along their whole path even over solid sky floor. Arc shells + CE ProjectileCE registered.

# PASS 37 — CROSS-LEVEL HAULING RESPECTS STORAGE-PRIORITY TIERS (built green, pending verify)
`WorkGiver_ABHaulToBetterLevelStorage` (priorityInType 20 > vanilla 15) fires only on beatsLocal; single + bulk. Monotone.

# PASS 36 — TRUE ONE-BIG-MAP WORK PRIORITY PARITY (USER-VERIFIED "tests good")
# PASS 36b — CROSS-GAP SHOOTERS RENDER THE WEAPON AIMED (USER-VERIFIED)
# PASS 36c — MODDED TURRET CROSS-LEVEL FIRE PARITY (built green, pending verify)
# PASS 35 — DBH COOLING + GRAVSHIP BLOCK + SAFE LEVEL DELETE + LEVELGEN HARDENING (built green, NOT yet user-verified)
# PASS 34 — HARDENING WAVE (built green, pending) · # PASS 33 — SEE-BELOW INPUT PARITY (USER-VERIFIED)

## Modern Dev Tools integration — SHIPPED About/known-issues.json
Ships `About/known-issues.json` so MDT explains our ABGuard subsystem shutdowns in-game. Inert without MDT.

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (round 7). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12). Stairwell heat exchange (2026-07-21). CROSS-LEVEL TRACERS (pass 38).

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · Batch A · mech charge crash gone · bill supply + mech RMB · PASS 33 see-below input parity · PASS 36 one-big-map work priority · PASS 36b cross-gap aim pose + selection-gated combat overlays.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 (VERIFIED) · basement (VERIFIED) · haul/ferry · cross-level storage-priority parity (p37) · below lighting · animal flows · mech charge (VERIFIED) · elevation lock (VERIFIED) · drag-box select (VERIFIED) · targeter widening (VERIFIED) · hover readout (VERIFIED) · selection-across-stairs (p33) · one-big-map work priority (p36, VERIFIED) · cross-gap aim pose (p36b, VERIFIED) · modded turret cross-level fire (p36c) · cross-gap combat visuals real 1:1 projectile (p38) · **CAI 5000: Phase 1 bridge + Phase 2 see-below honors CAI fog (option B, all configs) + Phase 3 cross-level vision reveal pass, all built green, pending in-game verify of see-below fog liveness (p39)** · MDT known-issues.json · P0-P3 parity. OUT OF SCOPE: cross-level designators, non-projectile turrets, feeding CAI threat-AI flags across the gap.

## Compat

Robots/++ · Hauler's Dream+PUAH · Allow Tool · Ancient urban ruins · CE (p38) · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage · Modern Dev Tools · Perspective: Ores · **CAI 5000 / Krkr.rule56 (p39: option B all-configs + cross-level vision reveal; Advanced AI free; reflection-only)** · turrets: any Building_Turret with a projectile verb (p36c) · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded, non-projectile/CE-verb turrets across levels.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE (run ISOLATED + dev-built column)
**PASS 39 (TOP) — CAI 5000 (companion Krkr.rule56, pulls Prepatcher):** Phase 1: `AB: ensure sky + basement` then `AB: CAI fog self-test` -> ALL PASS + Advanced AI coexists (run #209 clean). # As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** 900+ mods bury our diagnostics under 50+ unrelated startup/save-load errors. ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (e.g. just Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene when a DBH test is needed) + build a fresh column via the dev action "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement". The user's real column SAVE was made under the full list so it can't load isolated — test on a freshly generated column instead. Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (identity x/z; -2.5 y is altitude/sort only; 0.85 per-object shrink about each thing's own center).
- Selection survives column view switches AND pawn level-changes via stairs. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap. Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through.** Shared pattern: ONE render-aware hit-test + ONE input-scope adapter. Selection (in-place) + orders (stair routing) keep bespoke semantics.
- **Designators OUT OF SCOPE (user decision pass 33).**
- Logistics doctrine: every ferry MONOTONE. Storage=vanilla+capacity clamp + delivered-level retention (pass 34). Demand=shortfall+retention via PinnedByNativeNeed; in-flight ledger. Needs-bridge, work-migration hysteresis.
- **WORK doctrine (pass 36): the column is ONE BIG MAP for work priority.** Strictly-higher-priority (earlier-ranked) work on ANY level preempts a pawn's current job immediately; equal-priority work on another level is only taken once the current level's targets of that type are exhausted ("complete level-to-level tasks before moving on"). Forbidden/full-storage/forced-work parity is inherited by running vanilla's own scan at a virtual stairwell-exit position.
- **COMBAT doctrine: cross-map verb casts are impossible (engine map guard), so we spawn projectiles on the TARGET map and run our own warmup/burst/cooldown driver.** Turret support is CAPABILITY-based (any Building_Turret whose AttackVerb is a Verb_LaunchProjectile, vanilla or modded, any faction); non-projectile (beam/laser/CE-verb) turrets are out of scope.
- **Soft-compat HARD RULE (relearned pass 35):** foreign types (DBH/VEF/Rimefeller) must NEVER appear in a method SIGNATURE or field — locals in method bodies only, or object-typed params cast on entry — because assembly-wide attribute scans resolve signatures even for never-called methods and hard-crash when the mod is absent. Entry points gated by ABDetect / manual-only patches.

# PASS 36 — TRUE ONE-BIG-MAP WORK PRIORITY PARITY (USER-VERIFIED "tests good")
User directive: work-priority parity across all 3 levels so pawns treat the column as ONE BIG MAP — strictly-higher-priority work anywhere preempts immediately; equal-priority work on another level is only taken once the current level's targets of that type are exhausted; plus vanilla parity for forbidden items, full storage, forced work.

**KEY INSIGHT:** rank-exact "strictly-better preempts" is provably non-thrashing (rank is a total order — cannot have rank(A)<rank(B) AND rank(B)<rank(A)), and vanilla only re-runs JobGiver_Work at JOB TRANSITIONS, so a busy pawn finishes its current job before re-evaluating = "complete before moving on" for free. The old 900t betterWorkCooldown + 1200t arrivalCommitment + colony-wide 2-probes/tick budget were compensating for a NOISY metric (version-bump re-arms, probe-time cooldown erosion), not for a real ping-pong risk — so they could leave genuinely higher-priority remote work WAITING (the core parity break the user reported).

**CHANGES (Source/Movement/CrossLevelWork.cs):**
1. **BETTER-WORK PATH** (busy pawn, local job exists) now preempts IMMEDIATELY for strictly-higher-ranked remote work: dropped `betterWorkCooldown` and the `arrivalCommitment` gate. The cheap `LevelWorkSummary.AnyPlausibleBefore` check runs UNBUDGETED first; only the expensive virtual scan claims the colony-wide probe budget. Denied pawns keep the local job and retry next transition (near-immediate, no cooldown). Added a 250t per-pawn NEGATIVE-PROBE memo (`betterWorkNegativeMemo`) charged only after an expensive scan finds nothing, bypassed by any work-version bump.
2. **IDLE PATH** now picks the GLOBALLY highest-priority level: `TryMigrateForWork` scans BOTH linked levels and keeps the better-ranked hit (`RankOf` via `WorkGiversInOrderNormal`; -1 non-scan = top; ties -> upper). Kept its `migrationCooldown` + `idleReturnHome`.
3. **arrivalCommitment** retained but now checked ONLY by the rank-BLIND robot probe (`ProbeWorkAt`, Misc. Robots); cheap re-add point if reservation-race bounce ever surfaces.

Forbidden/full-storage/forced-work parity for the WORK SCAN is inherited from running vanilla's own `giver.TryIssueJobPackage`/`HasJobOnThing` at the virtual stairwell-exit. Also fixed a false-positive asset drift (`Building_ABStairs` used a fully-qualified `ContentFinder<UnityEngine.Texture2D>` the manifest scanner couldn't see — added a `using Texture2D = UnityEngine.Texture2D;` alias).

# PASS 36b — CROSS-GAP SHOOTERS RENDER THE WEAPON AIMED (USER-VERIFIED)
Cross-level (Model B) shooters didn't play the aim animation. Root cause: the renderer (`PawnRenderUtility.DrawEquipmentAndApparelExtras`) only draws a weapon AIMED when `curStance is Stance_Busy` with a valid `focusTarg`; the custom `JobDriver_ABCrossLevelAttack` set no stance, so gun-wielders rendered carried-openly. Fix: render-only `Stance_ABCrossAim : Stance_Busy` (no cast on expire, no warmup pie) set/refreshed every FireTick with `focusTarg = target THING on the paired map`; the renderer's `AngleFlat` uses x/z only, which the plumb below-view maps identically, so the muzzle points where the target appears. Cleared in a finish action. Also (same report follow-up, USER-VERIFIED): the engagement LINE + warmup aim pie + target marker are now selection-gated (`Find.Selector.IsSelected`) for BOTH pawns and turrets — vanilla parity, since those are selection overlays; the weapon aim POSE still renders for every shooter.

# PASS 36c — MODDED TURRET CROSS-LEVEL FIRE PARITY (built green, pending verify)
User directive: make sure turrets, INCLUDING MODDED ones, fire across levels. Audit finding: the cross-level turret system (`Source/Combat/CrossLevelTurret.cs`) is already CAPABILITY-based and `Building_Turret`-generic — the abstract base exposes `AttackVerb`/`CurrentTarget`/`ForcedTarget`/`OrderAttack`, so the firing driver (`TickPair`), the auto-acquire scan backstop (`AcquireFromList` iterates `Building_Turret`), and the player-order path (`CrossLevelTargeting.TryHandleTurret` -> `TryOrder`, all base-class) already fire ANY turret whose `AttackVerb` is a `Verb_LaunchProjectile` (or subclass), vanilla or modded, arc (mortars) or direct, both directions. Wired via `LevelComp` (`TickPair` per tick, `AcquireAuto` on the engage scan). Only `Building_TurretGun`-specific niceties are the 15-tick fast-acquire hook (`TryFindNewTarget` postfix) and the cancel gizmo (`GetGizmos` postfix); non-`TurretGun` modded turrets still FIRE (auto via the 250-tick scan, player via the generic order) but react slower and lack a cancel gizmo — documented, not blocking.
**FIX (parity gap that affected vanilla mech-cluster/EMP AND modded turrets):** `ReadyToFire` only checked power + manning, so a DORMANT mech-cluster turret, an EMP-STUNNED turret, a HACKED turret, or a modded turret gated by dormancy/initiation/mech-power-cell could still cross-fire while disabled. Now `ReadyToFire` defers to `Building_Turret.ThreatDisabled(turret)` (one call covering power, manning, dormancy, initiation, mech power cell, hacking, never-a-threat) + a `CompStunnable.StunHandler.Stunned` check, wrapped in try/catch that falls back to the old manual power+manning gates if a modded `ThreatDisabled` throws. This gates BOTH firing (`TickPair`->`TryFireOne`) and auto-acquisition (`AcquireFromList`), so disabled turrets neither acquire nor fire across the gap — exactly as same-map. Player pre-targeting (`TryOrder`) stays permissive (fires when able), matching vanilla forced-target. HARD LIMIT unchanged: non-projectile verbs (beam/laser, CE's custom verb hierarchy) are not simulated.

# PASS 35 — DBH COOLING + GRAVSHIP BLOCK + SAFE LEVEL DELETE + LEVELGEN HARDENING (built green, NOT yet user-verified)
1. **DBH air-conditioning cross-level cooling** (parity with the VTE AC bridge): DBH cooling rides its own `PlumbingNet` (`PipeType.Air`) where `CoolingCap` is recomputed EVERY tick by `HygienePipeMapComp.MapComponentTick`, so a periodic bridge can't hold it — implemented as a manual postfix on that tick (`DBHAirconPatch`, DBH-active only) driving `DBHAirconBridge.PoolForMap`, pooling per-map-local outdoor+indoor capacity across air-duct riser pairs and rewriting only this map's Air-net CoolingCap. New defs `AB_VerticalAirDuct Up/Down` + `bridgeAircon` flag. Gated by crossLevelPipes + ABGuard.Pipes.
2. **Gravship build-block** for all vertical links (`ABGravship.OnSubstructure`, Odyssey-gated) wired into `PlaceWorker_ABStairs.AllowsPlacing` + a guard in `EstablishLink`; reject `AB_NoLevelsGravship`.
3. **Safe single-level deletion** (`Building_ABStairs` gizmo -> `Dialog_ABDeleteLevel` -> `ABLevelDeletion.DeleteLevel`): never the ground; jumps view to ground; evacuate ON (default) relocates player pawns/slaves/animals/mechs/prisoners/guests near a ground stair landing, then `PocketMapUtility.DestroyPocketMap`. Kill switch: world.
4. **LevelGen FinalizeInit-postfix hardening**: a Harmony finalizer on `Map.FinalizeInit` active only during our generation swallows + names third-party faults (a foreign post-processor like Perspective: Ores crashing on our solid-rock basement can't abort our level); plus a targeted `PerspectiveOresCompat` prefix skipping our pocket levels.

# PASS 34 — HARDENING WAVE (built green, user-verification pending)
1. Storage-full haul loop killed (condition-based monotone delivered-level retention). 2. GiddyUp raider dismount-spam fixed. 3. Mech-recharge hardened. 4. Allow Tool urgent hauling re-parented to HaulingUrgent. 5. ABBlame culprit naming wired into Disable + settings + Messages.

# PASS 33 — SEE-BELOW INPUT PARITY (USER-VERIFIED)
RMB building hit-test, elevation-lock hardening, cross-level drag-box select, targeter widening, hover mouseover readout.

## Modern Dev Tools integration — SHIPPED About/known-issues.json
Ships `About/known-issues.json` (18 issues) so MDT explains our ABGuard subsystem shutdowns in-game. No dependency, inert without MDT.

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (round 7). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12). Stairwell heat exchange (2026-07-21) — cross-level TEMPERATURE now flows only through DBH aircon (pass 35) and VTE/VEF pipe bridges.

## VERIFIED (USER)

Manually: a mech-cluster/dormant enemy turret must NOT cross-fire until activated; an EMP-stunned turret must stop; a hacked/unpowered/unmanned turret must hold.
